status: source evidence inventory; not an accepted operation definition, runtime proof or retention approval

methodology.reads: Python AST, literal Rust registries and static UI invocation scanning only; no product imports, help execution, model/backend startup or network calls
methodology.precision: observed keys/checks and callsites are source facts; dynamic bindings and branch-specific contracts remain explicit unresolved work. HTTP request_result_authorization_evidence resolves through python_http_handler_evidence; omitted request requiredness/types and effective authorization always remain unresolved unless explicitly stated.
methodology.proposal_rule: all proposed_operation values are proposal_only; none grants authority or defines accepted schemas
methodology.retention_rule: legacy person registration, rebind, grants, authority and other restricted paths remain inventoried; no legacy trust migration is approved
coverage_limits: CLI dynamic loops/helper parents and runtime-created registrations require review
HTTP condition sites are not a normalized route trie; method observations are handler-wide
UI variable path expressions and indirect wrapper calls require data-flow review; literal node caller joins do not prove unused methods
Rust params lists define accepted key names, not complete requiredness/types/results
Public client/export and MCP availability depend on packaging/features; static presence is not installed availability
methodology.source_reference_rule: file_ref and registry_ref resolve through source_files; line and symbol remain at each call/declaration; note_ref resolves through shared_evidence_notes. Digests bind the observed source bytes.
methodology.source_location_encoding: source locations are [file_ref,line_or_null,symbol]; resolve file_ref through source_files. proposed_operation values are proposals only, never accepted IDs.
